arguments.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: S31 production model sheet, FRONT POOL LOOK. Create a native 1536x1024 landscape PNG. Exactly ONE full-body front view of the adult Han Sora, standing alone at the centre and filling almost the entire canvas height, with comfortable margin above her sunglasses and below her bare feet. Flat light grey #E9E9EC background, only a tiny soft contact shadow beneath the feet. Soft neutral upper-left key light. Level eye-height camera, about 1.6 m, long-lens model-sheet view without foreshortening, neutral standing reference pose. Nothing else for scale, no silhouette, no inset or second figure.

Input image 1 is the APPROVED S20 front.png: use its exact adult identity, heart-shaped face, amused dark eyes, red lips, winged eyeliner, black chin-length bob, matte skin palette and athletic curvy build. Input image 2 is the APPROVED S20 turnaround.png: use the SAME body proportions and head construction. These references are design references; change her outfit and wrist continuity to the Arc 5 pool look below. The former brass compass, black gloves, jacket, trousers, boots, crossbow and all tactical gear are absent in this pool outfit.

Draw her in an opaque matte BLACK ONE-PIECE swimsuit with a deep plunging V neckline, high-cut leg openings and narrow CRIMSON piping cleanly following the neckline, armholes and leg edges. Keep it recognisably one continuous swimsuit with the front abdomen covered. Straightforward attached shoulder straps; simple scoop back for later views. Big plain black sunglasses are pushed UP into the top of her sleek chin-length bob, leaving her eyes unobstructed. Bare feet, each anatomically correct, five toes. Adult proportions matching the reference: about 7.5 heads tall, legs roughly half of total height, no shortened torso or enlarged head.

Critical left/right locks: a clean WHITE BANDAGE wraps only her anatomical RIGHT wrist, on PICTURE-LEFT in this front view. On her anatomical LEFT wrist, PICTURE-RIGHT, a fine SILVER CHAIN carries ONE small round SLIM SILVER-CASED compass charm, its glass face and single smoky-violet CORE-SLIVER NEEDLE visible. The silver compass hangs just beside the left hand against the grey so its case, chain and correct wrist can be clearly checked. There is no brass compass and no compass on her bandaged right wrist.

Her posture is relaxed with a slight hip shift and an amused small red smile, shoulders counterbalanced, weight clearly on one leg. Both arms hang slightly away from the hips so both wrist locks are entirely visible. Unclenched hands have five distinct anatomically correct fingers, no gloves. The composition presents the whole character evenly at eye level, her face the acting focus. Crisp ink and large simple cool cel-shadow shapes, matte cloth and matte skin, restrained small hair shine. No glossy rendered anatomy, busy shading or cosmetic airbrush gradients.
